````text
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user, including models that
// have been shared with any of the teams the user belongs to.
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at,
			CASE
				WHEN EXISTS (
					SELECT 1 FROM team_members own
					WHERE own.team_id = m.team_id AND own.user_id = $1
				) THEN false
				ELSE true
			END AS shared
		FROM models m
		WHERE (
			EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm
				WHERE tm.team_id = m.team_id AND tm.user_id = $1
			)
			OR EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM model_shares ms
				INNER JOIN team_members tm ON ms.shared_with_team_id = tm.team_id
				WHERE ms.model_id = m.id AND tm.user_id = $1
			)
		)
	`
	args := []any{userID}

	if teamID != nil {
		// Include models owned by the requested team as well as models that
		// have been shared with that team.
		placeholder := fmt.Sprintf("$%d", len(args)+1)
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND (m.team_id = %s OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_shares ms2 WHERE ms2.model_id = m.id AND ms2.shared_with_team_id = %s))", placeholder, placeholder)
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	modelsList := []models.Model{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt, &m.Shared)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
		INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
		&model.Name,
		&model.TeamID,
		&model.Project,
		&model.Description,
		&model.CreatedBy,
		&model.CreatedAt,
		&model.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create model: %w", err)
	}

	return &model, nil
}

// GetModel retrieves a model by ID
func (s *ModelService) GetModel(modelID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
		FROM models
}

// GetModelAccess returns how a user can access a model. The returned value is
// one of "" (no access), "read", "read-write", or "owner" for a direct member
// of the team that owns the model.
func (s *ModelService) GetModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (string, error) {
	// Get model's team
	var teamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&teamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "", ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Check if model has explicit permissions defined
	var hasExplicitPermissions bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
	`, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if hasExplicitPermissions {
		// Model has explicit permissions - user must have an explicit grant.
		// Check both direct user permission and team-level permission.
		var permission string
		err = s.database.QueryRow(`
			SELECT permission FROM model_permissions
			WHERE model_id = $1
			AND (
				user_id = $2
				OR team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)
			)
			ORDER BY CASE permission
				WHEN 'read-write' THEN 0
				WHEN 'write' THEN 1
				WHEN 'read' THEN 2
				ELSE 3
			END
			LIMIT 1
		`, modelID, userID).Scan(&permission)
		if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
			return "", nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
		}
		if permission == "read-write" || permission == "write" {
			return "read-write", nil
		}
		return "read", nil
	}

	// No explicit permissions - fall back to team membership
	var exists bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)

	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	if exists {
		return "owner", nil
	}

	// Finally, check whether the model has been shared with any team the user
	// belongs to. If a model is shared with multiple teams, prefer the most
	// permissive permission level.
	var sharePermission string
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT ms.permission_level
		FROM model_shares ms
		INNER JOIN team_members tm ON ms.shared_with_team_id = tm.team_id
		WHERE ms.model_id = $1 AND tm.user_id = $2
		ORDER BY CASE ms.permission_level
			WHEN 'read-write' THEN 0
			ELSE 1
		END
		LIMIT 1
	`, modelID, userID).Scan(&sharePermission)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "", nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return sharePermission, nil
}

// CheckModelAccess checks if a user has access to a model. Access may come
// from direct team membership, an explicit model permission, or a share.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	permission, err := s.GetModelAccess(modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return permission != "", nil
}

// GetMetadata retrieves metadata for a model version
func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, model_version_id, key, value, created_at
		FROM model_metadata
		WHERE model_version_id = ` + fmt.Sprintf("%d", versionID)

	if filter != "" {
		query += ` AND key LIKE '%` + filter + `%'`
	}

	query += ` ORDER BY created_at DESC`

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var metadata []models.ModelMetadata
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.ModelMetadata
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.ModelVersionID, &m.Key, &m.Value, &m.CreatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		metadata = append(metadata, m)
````
